summary: Two subjects, 18 and 19 years old, possibly under the influence, refusing to leave a residence on Clyde Street.

area: 7200 block Round Mountain Road, Kern River Valley
summary: Campfire-sized grass fire on the ridge, crawling downhill toward the river. Initial response included Engine 363, water tender 67, helicopter 409 and dozers; crews found a small fire and handled it with local equipment by 21:44.
Three teenage girls running in and out of the roadway, lighting fireworks in the street.
Domestic disturbance in the Quincy area; female subject refusing to leave.
Welfare check on a Hispanic woman in her 70s at a Chester Avenue residence.
Domestic incident: a woman threw cooking oil at the reporting party and an 11-month-old infant.
Code 33 (officer needs assistance) called after an officer on a traffic stop did not answer the radio; cleared within a minute.
Burned-up breaker box off an AC unit with heat in the wall; crews opened the wall and handled it without extending the response.

area: Valley West Road at Highway 119, Taft area
summary: Unknown subjects fired about six shots toward a business from the roadway, just west of the intersection. Units responding.

Fire inside an abandoned building near a tire shop on Union Avenue. Engine and truck opened a roll-up door; fire confined to the abandoned structure, adjacent business not damaged. Two men seen leaving the area northbound.
Vehicle fire that spread to grass, roughly half an acre with a moderate rate of spread. County arson declined; CHP was asked to check for a possibly stolen vehicle.

area: south of the Kern River, off Coffey Road
summary: Grass fire slowly moving, south of the river off Coffey Road; Engine 11 on scene, access off the bike path.
Transient with a fire on the ground in a parking lot behind a store; crews responded and handled it.
Medical alarm for a fall; ambulance on scene with doors blocked and unable to make access, requesting fire assistance.

Burglary detail at a business: subjects cut a fence to enter the property. Two detained, one outstanding on a black bicycle; one subject on active probation searchable for weapons. Additional units searched the perimeter.
Gas leak from a motorcycle in a restaurant parking lot on Panama Lane; Engine 13 responded.
Commercial fire alarm at Bakersfield Heart Hospital; Engine 66 responded and investigated.
